scope: Opt-in bounded discovery and reuse of extra Sentinel endpoints in master and replica pools.
cases: Copied configured endpoints, duplicate rejection, append-only cap and exact deduplication.
Empty/malformed/down/over-limit peers, optional timeout and optional ACL error do not alter a verified data path.
Two stale ROLE attempts discard the peer list and issue the optional command only once.
Learned seed authentication failure falls back to the configured seed.
Real Sentinel loss: original process exits and its port refuses connections; the learned process supplies the replacement while two original leases remain usable.
Default master/replica failover and active topology remap regressions use the unchanged indexed factory APIs.
